title: European Chips Act
summary: EU industrial policy aiming to double Europe's share of global chip production.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The European Chips Act, in force since 2023, combines €43bn of public and private funding with a target of 20% of global semiconductor production by 2030, up from roughly 10%. It subsidises fabs, packaging and design capacity, with Germany, France and Italy as the main recipients. The gap between announced capacity and actual output is the number to watch.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2023–2030
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Subsidy announcements are not capacity; the test is tool move-in and qualified output.

What Would Change The View

  • Fab construction and tool move-in.
  • Actual share of global output.
  • Workforce availability.

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
